Fried rice and lo mein add up fast on refined carbs — a smaller portion plus extra vegetables balances it out.

matcha.label: Matcha
watchNotes: A standard sweetened matcha latte can carry as much sugar as a dessert.
Sipping something sweet slowly over hours is harder on teeth than drinking it in one sitting.
Some shops use flavored syrups with more sugar in them than the matcha itself.
